_comment: Every word the How-to page says that is not a how-to's own content, for BOTH apps: the desktop page (src/gui/pages/how_to/words.rs, w("key")) and the website's (web/pages/how-to-app.js, W('key')). One file, so the two say the same thing, and the file a translation will copy: words.<lang>.json beside it, keys unchanged (English only for now; docs/design/how-to.md, 'Accessibility and languages'). {name} marks a value the page fills in. A test (src/gui/pages/how_to/tests.rs) fails on a key either app uses that is not here, and on a key here that neither uses. The desktop app keeps a built-in copy (src/embedded_data.rs) so the page never shows a bare key.

words.title: How-to
words.line: Step-by-step how-tos for real life and for this app: what you need, the steps to tick off, the timers, and what to do when something goes wrong.
words.how_lists: How-tos are sorted by where in life a task sits. A dimmed one is planned and not written yet: shown so you can see what is missing.
words.how_views: Short shows the steps and every safety line; Full adds the reasons and the details. Short never leaves out a safety line that can seriously hurt or kill.
words.how_runs: Start keeps your progress, step by step, on this device only, and nothing is sent anywhere. Close the app or restart the computer and you carry on where you left off; timers keep running while it is closed.
words.how_review: Every how-to says where its facts come from and when they were read. One that can kill if done wrong shows as checked only after a person has read it and dated it, and a how-to whose words changed after it was checked says so.
words.how_ai: Written by an AI means a person has not written it; until it is checked it says so beside the hazard.
words.search_hint: Search, or describe what you see
words.could_not_show_line: These files in the data folder did not pass the checker, so they are not shown:
words.list_empty: Nothing here matches. Clear the search, or choose All how-tos.
words.choose_one: Choose a how-to to see it here.
words.view_tip: Short: the steps and every safety line. Full: the reasons and the details too.
words.start_tip: Keeps your progress on this device. Ticking a step starts one too.
words.action_later: This step presses a button in the app's admin tools, which arrives with a later increment.
words.removed_step: This step was removed since you started: {id}
words.changed_since_start: This how-to changed since you started this run.
words.get_help: Get help: see Stop and call someone if, at the top.
words.history_none: You have not done this one yet.
words.planned_line: Planned, not written yet. When it is written it will say:
words.runs_kept: Your runs are kept on this computer only, in {folder}.
words.hazard_lethal: Can kill you if done wrong
